# Third-Party Files

This project includes small public-domain hUGETracker/hUGEDriver files so the ROM can build without relying on Jeremy's local folders.

- `hUGEDriver/include/hUGEDriver.h`
- `hUGEDriver/gbdk/hUGEDriver.lib`
- `tools/uge2source.exe`

Sources:

- hUGEDriver 6.1.3: https://github.com/SuperDisk/hUGEDriver/releases/tag/v6.1.3
- hUGETracker 1.0.11: https://github.com/SuperDisk/hUGETracker/releases/tag/v1.0.11
